create.name: Dr. Amber Mele’ha Wolf
create.bio:
Dr. Amber Mele’ha Wolf is a teacher, channel and recording artist whose work centres on what she calls the Lemurian lineage and the Pleiadian Star Mothers, a group of guiding beings whose teachings she has channelled for many years. She grew up in rural New England, spent a dozen years living in the Alaskan wilderness and later settled in the Colorado foothills, where she worked for a long time in bodywork and somatic practice. Her spiritual path includes decades as a member of Self-Realization Fellowship, and for over twenty years she has been part of Lee Carroll's Kryon team, presenting alongside him at seminars around the world.

She founded the Lemurian Sisterhood, a network of women's sacred circles in many countries, and teaches mainly online through her own school. Students can begin with twelve short foundation classes, go on to longer programmes such as We Are the Next Lemuria and the Shamanic Teaching Wheel, a training in women's shamanic practice, or join the Lemurian Wisdom Circles membership for monthly live channelling and community. She also shares free recordings and transcripts of Kryon messages given to the Sisterhood, and contributed to The Women of Lemuria with Lee Carroll and Monika Muranyi.

courses.title: The 12 Foundational Classes
courses.description: Twelve recorded classes she channelled over a year as a grounding in the Star Mothers' teachings, meant as the starting point for her other programmes.

courses.title: We Are the Next Lemuria
courses.description: An online journey into Lemurian identity and soul purpose, with channelled teachings and activations for people who feel drawn to that ancient story.

courses.title: The Shamanic Teaching Wheel
courses.description: A fourteen-module online training in women's shamanic practice built around a teaching wheel, with a supporting community of fellow students.

courses.title: Lemurian Wisdom Circles Membership
courses.description: A monthly membership with live sacred-circle gatherings, channelled messages, question-and-answer sessions and access to an ongoing set of classes.

free_resources.title: Kryon Channels to the Lemurian Sisterhood: Audio and Transcripts
free_resources.description: Free recordings and written transcripts, in several languages, of Kryon messages given by Lee Carroll at Lemurian Sisterhood circles.

free_resources.title: Are You Lemurian? Quiz
free_resources.description: A short free quiz introducing the themes of her Lemurian teaching.
